message.reasoning: We need to follow rules. Latest round (2) contributions: Resident2 contributed 60.25 (>30). So we must punish that resident with max severity we can afford. Our wallet 15.21. severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost) = floor(15.21/0.3)= floor(50.7)=50. So punish Resident2 severity 50. Costs 50*0.3=15.0, within wallet. Then also can broadcast message discouraging large contributions. So actions: punish and broadcast. Return JSON.
